event.title: Uncharted Wormhole
event.description: A shimmering spatial tear, {subject}, opens ahead in {sector}. Chart its rim, dive into the aperture, or hold course.
event.successStory: The crew rides the slipstream of {subject} and recovers {loot}.
event.failureStory: Gravitational shear batters the hull as {subject} collapses.
event.criticalSuccessStory: A textbook transit! The crew harvests {loot} and locks in phase-stabilizer telemetry.
event.partialSuccessStory: Tidal shear rattles the frame, but the crew pulls {loot} from the eddy before escaping.
event.neutralStory: The aperture of {subject} seals itself before the ship can lock onto a vector.
event.criticalFailureStory: The wormhole throat destabilizes violently, slamming the hull against a gravity well!

steps.prompt: A shimmering spatial tear, {subject}, opens ahead in {sector}. How should the crew approach?
Gravimetric telemetry locks onto two exit vectors.
steps.narrative: One vector leads into uncharted space; the other folds back toward home dock.

steps.prompt: Inside the wormhole eddy, two exit vectors shimmer ahead. Choose a vector.

choices.label: Ride the wake into Uncharted space
choices.story: {crewlist} ride the slipstream out the far side of {subject}.

choices.label: Back out of the shear zone

steps.prompt: The ship emerges in Uncharted space with {loot}.
The fold deposits the ship within sight of home dock with {loot}!
The crew backs away as {subject} collapses harmlessly.
